participation.context: Wrote the line, and closed his hand on the tables.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You put the line on the tables at the stall. The aisle did not hear it.

title: Wrote that the king stays in Shoreditch

participation.context: Spoke, and stopped before the number.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You said what June was and what November is. You did not describe the cut. You said it walking, and did not stop.

title: Said June was a chronicle and November a pamphlet

participation.context: Wrote it for the leaf, and not for the room.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You wrote that your poems and a book about the crown are not the same thing, which you had not said at the Hazel. You did not go back and say it.

title: Wrote that the poems are another thing from the book about the crown
